text: On Jack's GPU the server cannot render into a linear XRGB8888 dmabuf: binding it fails with 'Failed to bind Framebuffer', and GBM reports the buffer's modifier as INVALID. So decade script (src/script.rs) offers the GPU's render formats and reads frames back through the renderer (copy_framebuffer) instead of mapping a linear buffer. Found by trial on 2026-11-07.
